verdict.rationale: Flagsmith has a public GitHub repository (Flagsmith/flagsmith), and its docs describe self-hosting the complete platform via Docker and Kubernetes, which strongly suggests the source is publicly readable. However, nothing in the evidence names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: explicit statement of an open-source license (e.g., BSD/MIT/Apache), and clarity on whether enterprise features are under a different license.
